description:
Signal: cargo test --test fz2_cli fails on Enum fixtures. enum_take_positive_single and enum_predicate_search fail Cranelift verification because a call supplies four arguments to a five-argument callable signature. enum_take_drop_split fails native callable materialization because one clause receives incompatible physical ABI resolutions.

Goal: restore JIT and AOT execution for these existing fz2 Enum fixture contracts without suppressing diagnostics or relaxing the CLI tests.

Strategy: trace each failing callable from runtime demand through native ABI specialization; make its callable boundary identity include every representation-affecting input, then prove the affected JIT/AOT fixtures execute again.
title: Repair native Enum callable ABI regressions exposed by fz2 CLI
